description: Lists the sessions of the movies of Cavea on one date that have not started, in the order of the start time. Narrow the list by a movie, a cinema, an audio language, or a format. Returns the cinema, the hall, the start time, the languages, the formats, the price in lari, and the occupancy level of each session. With a movie, each session has the price of each seat class. With no movie, it has the price of the class Standard. Use the session code in cinema_get_seat_map. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

audio_language.description: The language of the sound: ka or en.

cinema.description: The code of a cinema from cinema_list_cinemas.

date.description: The date in Tbilisi, YYYY-MM-DD. The default is today. Cavea publishes about 3 days.

format.description: One format: 3d, imax, dolby_atmos, screenx, or infinity_vision.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of sessions, 1 to 100. The default is 30.

movie.description: The code of a movie from cinema_list_movies or cinema_search_movies.

name: cinema_list_sessions

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the sessions, RFC 3339.

occupancy_as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the occupancy levels, RFC 3339.

occupancy_note.description: Why the sessions have no occupancy level.

sessions.description: The sessions, in the order of the start time, then the cinema code.

audio_language.description: The language of the sound: ka or en.

formats.description: The formats of the session. Empty for a 2D session.

hall.description: The hall: a number or a name, for example 5 or IMAX.

prices.description: The price of each seat class. Standard only when the request has no movie.

class.description: The seat class: economy, standard, vip, or status.

price.description: The price of one ticket in lari, as a decimal string.

start.description: The start of the session, RFC 3339 with the offset of Tbilisi.

subtitle_language.description: The language of the subtitles: ka or en. Absent when the session has none.

source.description: The source of the data: Cavea.

stale.description: True when Cavea did not answer and the server returns sessions it read before.

total.description: The count of sessions that matched. More than the count of sessions when the limit cut the list.

title: List the sessions of Cavea
